title: Agent QA signal write overwrites kernel-written rubric signals
description: The End-of-Skill Review phase writes the complete signals array to the signals file, overwriting kernel-written signals from verify_rubrics. Kernel integrity signals (rubric fails) are erased before inspection, reducing forensic value.
proposed_resolution: Update the skill's End-of-Skill Review write step to read existing signals and append QA signals rather than overwriting, or split kernel and QA signals into separate files.
